# Anivora 0.1.37 — Startup, loading feedback and quiet offline updates

- Show a visible green tick for selected Manual Fetch categories, including All Categories. The tick no longer depends on an icon font.
- Use “No comments, Be the first” for empty comments, including an empty cache during a server outage. Keep the separate outage/retry message and show real saved comments when available.
- Hold the intro's final frame, lift the logo slightly and show a short green-spinner handoff. Open the app without waiting for network requests; hydrate Home from its saved catalogue and refresh in the background.
- Pulse detail/search skeletons smoothly, respecting reduced-motion preferences and stopping animation in the background.
- Remove the GitHub background-check failure popup. Offline checks stop, pending checks cancel, and checks resume silently on reconnect/foreground. Keep validated mandatory updates, download/install actions and public GitHub distribution intact.
- Preserve native playback, Cast/PiP, downloads/HLS/merge, on-device manga, remote avatars, the Profile TV pairing entry, server notices and Cloudflare pages. Unprepared social links and support payments remain inactive.
- Activate the owner-provided Discord invite in Profile and on the homepage.

Android version code: **39**, newer than 0.1.36/code 38. Package:
`com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The original signing
certificate is retained; install over the existing app without uninstalling.

## Validation and limits

Release gates include TypeScript/lint, app and backend tests, Expo compatibility,
native unit tests, Android 14 download/HLS regressions, exact compiled source,
package/version/signer inspection and public download checksums. Controlled UI
checks exercise the real bundled intro, placeholders, selection, comments and
cached Home/reconnect. The release includes its exact commit and SHA-256.

Physical Hot 50i animation/network and Chromecast QA are pending; no certification
is claimed. Provider restrictions and the running-backend requirement for account
features/TV pairing remain. Background feed failures are silent; an already known
mandatory update and explicit download/installation failures still have their
existing UI.

See [startup and offline behavior](startup-and-offline.md),
[player behavior](player-chrome.md), and [0.1.36 notes](releases/0.1.36.md).
